jcr_content.jcr:title: TQMxE40M COM Express® Mini Module (Type 10)
jcr_content.jcr:description: The COM Express® Mini Type 10 Module TQMxE40M, featuring 6th Generation Intel Atom® x6000 series processors, offers a powerful and versatile computing solution
jcr_content.keywords: 6th Generation Intel Atom® x6000 series, Dual/Quad Core, LPDDR4, LPDDR4 Memory, In-Band ECC, eMMC Flash, PCIe Gen3, Gbit Ethernet, USB 3.1, Extended Temperature, Compact Form Factor, Embedded Computing, Industrial Automation, Image Processing, Rugged Applications

textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® x6000 Series, Pentium® and Celeron® Processors of 6th Generation ("Elkhart Lake")

The COM Express® Mini Type 10 Module TQMxE40M, featuring 6th Generation Intel Atom® x6000 series processors, offers a powerful and versatile computing solution for various applications. With dual/quad-core processing power that can reach up to 2.9 GHz, this module delivers impressive performance. It supports up to 16 GB of LPDDR4 memory with optional in-band ECC, ensuring data integrity.

In terms of connectivity, the module provides 1x Gbit Ethernet, 2x USB 3.1 (Gen2), and 8x USB 2.0 ports, along with up to 4 PCIe lanes (Gen3). It also offers dual display support with options for DP (4K), eDP (4K), or LVDS (Single Channel). The module comes with up to 256 GB of soldered eMMC Flash storage, making it suitable for a wide range of storage-intensive applications.

One of the module's standout features is its extended temperature support, ranging from -40°C to +85°C, ensuring reliability in harsh environments. It caters to applications in industrial automation, aviation, medical technology, and more.

The TQMxE40M COM Express Mini Type 10 Module is designed with flexibility in mind, offering options for eMMC flash memory, display interfaces, and additional functions. Its low power dissipation, compact COM Express Mini form factor (84 mm x 55 mm), and enhanced graphics and image processing capabilities make it a compelling choice for demanding tasks.

With features like PCIe Gen 4 lanes, Intel graphics processor, and support for real-time applications, this module is poised to excel in fields like gaming, machine vision, virtual reality, and industrial automation, where high-performance computing is essential. It also supports AI and image processing tasks efficiently, thanks to its vector neural networks instruction set (VNNI).

text.text:
Features

  • Powerful Processing: 6th Generation Intel Atom® x6000 series processors deliver dual/quad-core computing power with clock speeds of up to 2.9 GHz

  • Memory and Storage Flexibility: 16 GB of LPDDR4 memory with optional in-band ECC for data integrity. Offers up to 256 GB of soldered eMMC Flash storage for efficient data handling.

  • Versatile Connectivity: Provides 1x Gbit Ethernet, 2x USB 3.1 (Gen2), 8x USB 2.0 ports, and up to 4 PCIe lanes (Gen3) for high-speed data transfer and peripheral connections.

  • Extended Temperature Range: Operate reliably in extreme conditions with a temperature range from -40°C to +85°C, ensuring suitability for rugged industrial environments.

  • Compact Form Factor: Features a compact COM Express Mini form factor (84 mm x 55 mm), making it space-efficient and adaptable for various embedded applications.
